implementation_changes.article_route: Added an append-only ArticleRoute record that binds the actual Article to current W23 COVER/admission, W26 optional source-selection material, exact Evidence, prior published Article or unpublished Dossier, and W34 correction case.
implementation_changes.short_form_review: Added a schema-v2 short-form independent Review and W15 path. It uses the same reviewer inquiries, author response, issue closure and adoption controls without inventing B1/B2/C records.
implementation_changes.weekly_role: W32 now requires a W23 placement for every non-cover entry. Only DEEP_THEME may occupy FEATURE; SOURCE_SELECTION/UPDATE_CORRECTION may occupy UPDATE. A short form cannot replace depth, and a deep Article cannot be relabelled as an update.

positive_checks.source_selection: Actual W26 excerpt material, SourceMap-backed Evidence, W23 SOURCE_SELECTION COVER/admission, ArticleRoute, independent Review with one inquiry/closure, PASS and W15 READY.
positive_checks.initial_fact: Verified fact/time/evidence/importance/unknowns/reopen conditions; no prior Article, Dossier or correction case is permitted.
positive_checks.follow_up: One prior published Article or unpublished ResearchDossier is required; at least one route Evidence must be beyond the prior basis.
positive_checks.correction: The exact old Article and current W34 correction case are required; the old excerpt must occur in both the old Article and the correction Article.
positive_checks.edition: A single reviewed HTML edition combines one DEEP_THEME feature with INITIAL_FACT, FOLLOW_UP and CORRECTION update entries; every entry has its exact W23 placement and current W15 adoption.

negative_checks.relabel: W23 article type and ArticleRoute short_form must agree.
negative_checks.repeat_as_follow_up: FOLLOW_UP rejects Evidence already present in the prior Article/revision.
negative_checks.wrong_correction_quote: CORRECTION rejects a quote absent from the old Article and correction Article.
negative_checks.edition_role: A short form cannot replace the weekly depth feature, and a DEEP_THEME Article cannot be relabelled as UPDATE.

controlled_binding_refresh.reason: The new W37 implementation/test files and technical implementation summaries changed the conservative managed-file and design binding contexts. All 21/59 bindings were explicitly reviewed; no progress or evidence was reset.

limits: All route content is an owned synthetic fixture, not a real frozen news case or user-approved sample.
Short-form Review is manually executed; admitted-model short-form review remains unimplemented.
No real W26 translation quality, independent L5 capability, user reading or full-edition visual review was performed.
W23/W24/W26/W31/W32/W34 and all formal prerequisites remain IN_PROGRESS or unaccepted.
W37 does not claim G02, publication, delivery or production readiness.
